topic: Theory: Kuma scattered the Straw Hats at Sabaody to deliver each to a mentor
title: Kuma Didn't Scatter The Straw Hats, He Delivered Them
description: Everyone remembers Sabaody as the crew's worst day. I think Bartholomew Kuma was quietly sending each one to someone who could make them stronger. Here is the theory and the canon behind it. Do you buy it?
comment: Was Kuma secretly helping the Straw Hats from the start, or just following orders and getting lucky? Pick one.

lines.text: Kuma didn't scatter the Straw Hats. He delivered them.

shot.fallback: giant bear-like man with a bible raising his paw

lines.text: Here's my read, and it starts at Sabaody, chapter 513.

shot.fallback: island of giant bubbles with a broken pirate

lines.text: Everyone remembers Luffy broken, sent flying, unable to save one friend.

shot.fallback: young pirate in a straw hat lying defeated

lines.text: But look at where the crew actually landed.
Zoro lands with Mihawk, the only swordsman alive who could actually teach him.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman facing a hawk eyed swordsman

lines.text: Sanji lands with Ivankov, a Revolutionary Army commander.

shot.fallback: blond cook next to a tall flamboyant fighter

lines.text: Luffy lands on Amazon Lily, an island no navy ship can touch.

shot.fallback: pirate on a hidden island of warrior women

lines.text: Three crew members. Three places no Marine could reach, and a teacher waiting at each.

shot.fallback: three pirates each facing a mentor

lines.text: People say it was random. Just bad luck and a lucky landing.
But Kuma was a Revolutionary Army member, and the Revolutionaries wanted Luffy alive.

shot.fallback: masked revolutionary leader with a tattoo

lines.text: That's not a scattering. That's a rescue.

shot.fallback: bear man turning away from a fallen crew

lines.text: Because Kuma didn't scatter the Straw Hats...

shot.fallback: giant bear-like man with a bible raising his paw
